title: Mark: the story at a run
note: Rebuilt on 2026-11-26 from the Bible Explorer film of the same slug. New wording, same facts: each claim is in the old film's captions or its 'differ' note, whose sources are in docs/work/elite/explorer-ledger.md. Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible, checked against client/public/bible/text/ by film/tools/write-script.py.

lines: Mark is the shortest of the four Gospels, and it moves at speed. There's no birth story and no long sermon. The word translated immediately appears more than forty times.
Its first line works as a title.
This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

scripture.text: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

lines: The first half is set in Galilee, full of authority and questions. Its hinge is Peter's confession.
From there the story walks the road to Jerusalem, tells the passion by the hour, and ends at an empty tomb.

chapters.kicker: Watch for: who is this man?
lines: The question of who Jesus is runs through the whole book. You know the answer from the first line.
The drama is in watching the characters struggle toward it, often getting the words right and the meaning wrong.

scripture.text: Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?

chapters.kicker: Watch for: the way of the cross
lines: On the road to Jerusalem, Jesus predicts his death and resurrection three times. And each time he teaches what following him means: deny yourself, and be the servant of all.
For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.

scripture.text: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.

lines: Mark doesn't flatter the disciples. They misunderstand. They fall asleep in Gethsemane. They flee. And Peter denies Jesus three times.
Yet the message at the tomb names Peter in particular.

scripture.text: But go, tell His disciples and Peter

chapters.kicker: Watch for: who sees it first
lines: The first human being in Mark to call Jesus the Son of God is a Roman centurion at the foot of the cross, at the moment of his death.
Truly this man was the Son of God!
The Son of God is recognized fully only at the cross.

scripture.text: Truly this man was the Son of God!

lines: Read Mark in one sitting if you can. Its force comes from its pace. The key chapters are one, four, eight, ten, thirteen, fifteen, and sixteen.
The oldest complete copies end with the women at the tomb.
Mark holds authority and suffering together.
